audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart read 'Skill' on rows 0-5 while the content layer read Karma/Karma/Skill/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia. Fifteen fields also referred to Cassiopeia as he/his/him.
audit.why: Karma's edge is genuinely only levels 1-2 — Twin Fang needs poison on the target first, and once Noxious Blast uptime is reliable the lane belongs to Cassiopeia. The packet levelChart agrees with the content layer.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved onto the content values (rows 0,1,3,4,5) with each why rewritten to match; every misgendered field corrected to she/her.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 row claimed Karma presses an early lead while ignoring Petrifying Gaze entirely, and no spike named a cooldown.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s at 825 range and stuns everyone facing her. Karma gains only a Mantra rank at 6, so the spike trade is one-sided.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t all built the matchup around Miasma 'grounding you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it'. Karma has no dash, leap or movement ability anywhere in her kit, so that is a template pasted from a mobile owner. The field also contained no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Against Karma specifically, Miasma's grounding finds nothing to deny; its slow is what actually pins her inside the poison. Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s at 700 range. The real decisive interaction is Twin Fang: 0.75s cooldown, 700 range, healing Cassiopeia for a share of the damage — which is what beats Karma's chip-and-shield pattern, and why Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Those three fields now state the 24s Miasma with its slow (not grounding) as the cost, and the 0.75s Twin Fang sustain with anti-heal as the answer.
sources: brief.ownerKit — Karma has no dash flag on any ability

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Noxious Trap' appears in spikes[0].text, early, mid (as 'poison-trap') and wants.foe[0]/wants.you[1]. Cassiopeia has no trap ability.
audit.why: Her Q is Noxious Blast. Noxious Trap is Teemo's R. Packet also flagged wants.foe[2] 'Land Petrifying Gaze' — that one is the correct Riot name and is a false positive; no edit made there.
audit.corrected: All Noxious Trap references replaced with Noxious Blast.

Play at max range, never walk through unrevealed trap zones, and treat her ult as lethal even from a distance. Her item spike only compounds this, letting single combos delete your HP bar. This whole stretch of the game belongs to her — your job is to survive it with minimal damage taken, not to contest it.

notes:
CHART: full layer read 'Skill' on rows 0-5; content read Karma/Karma/Skill/Cassiopeia x4, matching the packet levelChart. Full sides moved onto the content values (rows 0,1,3,4,5) and all seven whys rewritten. No paired win[N] edits included — win[0..6] already hold the target values on disk, so a pair would be before==after.

BIGGEST FIND: three fields built the whole matchup around Miasma grounding Karma's 'dashes and leaps'. Karma has no dash anywhere in her kit — it is a template pasted from a mobile owner and it was the page's headline advice. Replaced with what actually costs her: the slow holding her in the poison, and Twin Fang's 0.75s sustain that Grievous Wounds answers.

SCOPE NOTE: I edited seven report[] entries, above the two-per-matchup cap. Six of them (report[0],[1],[4],[8],[9],[11]) were mandatory MISGENDER lint fixes done as minimal pronoun swaps, not rewrites. Only report[5].t is a substantive rewrite, and it was the grounding-template fix.

SuspectNames false positive: wants.foe[2] 'Land Petrifying Gaze' is the correct Riot name; no edit.

UNVERIFIED, left alone: whether Miasma's grounding blocks Flash, whether Karma's Focused Resolve tether survives a Petrifying Gaze stun, and the exact facing arc on Petrifying Gaze. None are in Riot's text.
